'''Tarwin's Gap''' is a mountain pass marking the boundary between the [[Mountains of Dhoom]] and the [[Spine of the World]]. It had once been part of [[Malkier]], before that nation's fall.{{ref/book|13|e}}

Tarwin's Gap can be considered the location of [[Rand]]'s first appearance as the [[Dragon Reborn]] when he destroyed the [[Trolloc]] Army there after [[channel]]ing the pool of pure ''[[saidin]]'' at the [[Eye of the World]].

Tarwin's Gap was also used extensively during the [[Trolloc Wars]] to transport Trolloc troops from the [[Blight]] into the [[Westlands]].{{ref/book|11|20}}{{ref|how can that be true if it was part of a Westlands nation at the time ([[Aramaelle]])? The Blight did not cover what became Malkier until late in the Third Age.}}
